images.caption: Figure 1:Diagnosing error modes in a retrieve-then-verify pipeline.Top:the popular decompose-then-verify pipeline — decompose a response sentence into atomic facts, retrieve top-10 medical passages, ask an LLM verifier for a four-way label (Supported / Refuted / No Evidence / Ambiguous), and compare against a human verdict (True/False) made on the parent sentence (atomic facts inherit the sentence label by default).Bottom:our contribution is to induce, from these disagreements, a taxonomy of retrieval error modes (R1–R6, where the evidence itself is the bottleneck) and verification error modes (V1–V6, where the LLM reasons incorrectly over the evidence). Full error modes are inTable8andSectionA.2.
